title: Generative Artificial Intelligence Content Security Detection and Protection Platform
summary: China Telecom claims improved screening of political and ideological content; its reported classification performance does not establish a public-welfare benefit.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: A distilled and instruction-tuned model screens generated material against China Telecom’s political and ideological criteria. The provider reports broad use and approximately 6% false-positive and false-negative rates. The benefit described here is the provider’s claimed screening capability. Whether that capability improves public welfare is unresolved and is not inferred from model accuracy or network coverage.
purpose: Assist the provider in screening content against its stated policy criteria.
system: Generative Artificial Intelligence Content Security Detection and Protection Platform

ratings.reason: The provider claims enhanced detection of subtle policy-sensitive content, with approximately 6% false-positive and false-negative rates. This rating concerns its screening capability, not public welfare.

ai_role.statement: A learned language model identifies policy-sensitive expressions beyond simple keyword matching.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 5: Generative Artificial Intelligence Content Security Detection and Protection Platform

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: A telecom AI model screens content against provider policy

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
